meta_description: GEO in Ireland costs about €300–€1,500 a month from agencies. See euro price ranges, what is included and a fixed £89/mo option for small firms.

faq.q: How much does GEO cost in Ireland?
faq.a: Usually €200–€600 a month from a freelancer and €600–€1,500 or more from an agency. A one-off audit is about €300–€1,000.

faq.q: Do Irish GEO agencies charge VAT?
faq.a: VAT-registered Irish businesses add 23%. Always ask if a quote includes VAT.

faq.q: Is GEO worth it for a small Irish business?
faq.a: Yes if customers ask AI assistants for recommendations in your sector. Start with a small monthly plan and track which prompts mention you.

faq.q: Can a UK company do GEO for an Irish business?
faq.a: Yes. GEO is done remotely. ContentFellow's Search Fellow is £89 a month for SEO and GEO.
